THU AUG 20 4:10 AM PT RUN.

GOOGLE ADS -- Live Chrome scrape, account 343-687-4835, date filter 'Yesterday' = Aug 19. Account totals: 228 impressions, 11 clicks, $17.59 cost, $1.60 avg CPC, 4.82% CTR. That is down sharply from Aug 18 (1,050 impr / 34 clicks / $35.52 / $1.04 CPC). Per-campaign table pulled fresh and the cause is clear: 'Local store visits and promotions-Performance Max-2' ($58.37/day) is PAUSED -- it was Eligible and spending ~$49/day on Aug 18. 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap' and 'World Cup HQ 2026' also paused. Only 'BHC Coffee | Search | P1 Launch' ($15.00/day) is serving, and it accounts for the entire day's spend. Restaurant-side paid traffic is effectively dark. Zero ad disapprovals; 1 unread account notification and an account banner about the Aug 17 target-based bid strategy change. Needs Joal to confirm the pause was intentional.

TOAST -- No Wednesday Aug 19 email had arrived as of 4:10 AM PT (group lands ~6:25 AM, single-location ~7:30-7:45 AM). The Tuesday Aug 18 single-location Daily Performance Summary has now been parsed in full and backfilled: net $4,283.16 (+28.8% vs same day last week, -11.2% vs 4-week avg), gross $4,488.80, 181 guests (+13.1%), 134 orders (+20.7%), 141 checks, avg check $30.38, avg guest $23.66. Labor $1,068.66 = 25.0% of net vs 34.6% SDLW -- a strong improvement. Discounts $205.64, voids $57.00 (6 items / 3 orders), refunds $0. SLING -- Thursday Aug 20 daily report not in yet (lands ~7:00 AM PT). Last confirmed is Wednesday Aug 19: 7 employees / 7 shifts / 33.25 hrs / 0 uncovered / 0 overtime / 0 off, kitchen covered by Isael Salvador Narciso.

REVIEWS -- BOTH Google Business Profiles opened live in Chrome and the Unreplied tab read on-screen for each. The Brewhouse: 4.5 stars / 526 reviews, 2 unanswered (sergio salazar 5-star 4 days ago; Betty Chambers 5-star 1 week ago). Brewhouse Coffee: 5.0 stars / 5 reviews, 1 unanswered (Geoff Lay 5-star 5 days ago, Horchata Latte). All three are 5-star; drafts written and awaiting Joal's approval -- nothing posted. YELP -- 2 consumer marketing emails in 3 days, zero customer inquiries. Yelp Ads dashboard not re-checked; login wall since Aug 8, now day 13.

unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, a three-hour drive back is about the best compliment we get. Glad the crew was on point and the food delivered. We'll have a cold one waiting whenever you make that trip again -- thanks for the recommendation!

unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, so glad we were the right stop on your way down to San Diego -- and that your pup approved too. Our servers genuinely light up when the dogs come through. Water bowls are always ready if you're ever heading back up the coast.

unanswered.text: Wow. Horchata Latte? Yes please. Excellent service, even better Baristas. A must stop when in SB
unanswered.draftReply: Geoff, the Horchata Latte does tend to have that effect. Our baristas are going to be grinning about 'even better Baristas' all week. Thanks for making us a stop in SB -- see you at the bar.
